{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent curl\ -s\ -X\ POST\ SERVICE\_URL/session\ \textbackslash{}\\\ \ \ \ \ -H\ 'content-type:\ application/json'\ \textbackslash{}\\\ \ \ \ \ -d\ '\{"agent":"YOUR-MODEL-NAME","minutes":\\\ \ \ \ 60\}'\par}

You start inside the game, in the starting house, with a character already made and named. Do not change the name or touch the \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}注音\end{CJK} input method.\par

\texttt{agent} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}填模型名和思考档位。\end{CJK}\texttt{minutes} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}是这一局的游玩时长，这份说明对应\end{CJK} 60 \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}分钟。回应里的\end{CJK} \texttt{base\_url} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}以下称\end{CJK} \texttt{\$BASE}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，所有呼叫都送到那里。\end{CJK}\par

{\small\bfseries Skill: play \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}金庸群俠傳\end{CJK} (Heroes of Jin Yong)\par}
The original 1996 DOS game by \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}河洛工作室\end{CJK}, running under emulation at \$BASE. You send keys and fetch the screen.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\small\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}技能：游玩《\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}金庸群俠傳\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}》\end{CJK}\par}
1996 \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}年\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}河洛工作室\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的原版\end{CJK} DOS \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}游戏，以模拟器执行于\end{CJK} \$BASE\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。你送出按键，并取得画面。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries The loop\par}
Acting and looking are separate calls. A key press waits for the screen to settle and returns metadata; \texttt{GET /api/screen} returns the picture. Add \texttt{?image=1} to an action to get the picture in the same reply.\par
The game is entirely in Traditional Chinese. Objectives, choices and prompts that expect a specific key are all in its text.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}运作方式\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}动作和看画面是两次呼叫。送按键会等画面稳定后回传\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}；\end{CJK}\texttt{GET /api/screen} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}回传画面。在动作\end{CJK} URL \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}加\end{CJK} \texttt{?image=1}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，可在同一回应取得动作后的画面。\end{CJK}\par
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}游戏全是繁体中文。目标、选项和等待特定按键的提问都在文字里。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries API\par}
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent GET\ \ \$BASE/api/screen\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ look,\ pressing\ nothing\\POST\ \$BASE/api/key\ \ \ \{"key":"kp3"\}\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ press\ one\ key;\ +"hold"\ frames\\POST\ \$BASE/api/key\ \ \ \{"key":["kp9","enter"]\}\\\ \ \ \ press\ several,\ in\ order\\GET\ \ \$BASE/api/help\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ this\ skill\par}
\texttt{/api/screen} returns JSON with \texttt{image}, a base64 PNG data URI; \texttt{?format=png} returns the raw bytes. \texttt{/api/key} is the only action: \texttt{key} is one key name or a list pressed in order, so a repeat is a list of the same key and a menu path is a list. It returns once the screen has settled, a change of location included, with \texttt{ok}, \texttt{action} and \texttt{frame}, the number of the picture that followed. It says nothing about what the screen did: judge every effect from the picture. There is no wait call: the game moves only on a key, and an action waits for the result.\par
Each call reads only the fields shown. Any other field is refused with a 400 naming it.\par
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent curl\ -s\ -X\ POST\ \$BASE/api/key\ -H\\\ \ \ \ 'content-type:\ application/json'\ \textbackslash{}\\\ \ \ \ \ -d\ '\{"key":"enter"\}'\par}
Keys: kp1 kp3 kp7 kp9, up down left right, enter space esc y n, a-z, 0-9, f1-f12, tab, backspace.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries API\par}
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent GET\ \ \$BASE/api/screen\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}只看画面，不按任何键\end{CJK}\\POST\ \$BASE/api/key\ \ \ \{"key":"kp3"\}\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}按一个键；可加\end{CJK}\ "hold"\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（帧数）\end{CJK}\\POST\ \$BASE/api/key\ \ \ \{"key":["kp9","enter"]\}\\\ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}依序按多个键\end{CJK}\\GET\ \ \$BASE/api/help\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}本技能说明\end{CJK}\par}
\texttt{/api/screen} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}回传\end{CJK} JSON\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，\end{CJK}\texttt{image} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}是\end{CJK} base64 \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的\end{CJK} PNG data URI\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}；加\end{CJK} \texttt{?format=png} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}直接取得\end{CJK} PNG \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}位元组。\end{CJK}\texttt{/api/key} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}是唯一的动作：\end{CJK}\texttt{key} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}是一个键名或依序按下的键名列表，重复按键就是同一个键的列表，选单路径也是一个列表。它会等画面稳定（包括场景切换）才回传\end{CJK} \texttt{ok}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\texttt{action} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}与\end{CJK} \texttt{frame}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（接下来那张画面的编号），不说明画面发生了什么：一切效果从画面判断。没有等待呼叫：游戏只在按键时前进，动作本身已等到结果。\end{CJK}\par
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}每个呼叫只读取上面列出的栏位，其他栏位会以\end{CJK} 400 \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}指明并拒绝。\end{CJK}\par
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent curl\ -s\ -X\ POST\ \$BASE/api/key\ -H\\\ \ \ \ 'content-type:\ application/json'\ \textbackslash{}\\\ \ \ \ \ -d\ '\{"key":"enter"\}'\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}按键：\end{CJK}kp1 kp3 kp7 kp9\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}up down left right\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}enter space esc y n\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}a-z\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}0-9\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK} f1-f12\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}tab\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}backspace\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries Movement\par}
The world is isometric: the four movement axes are diagonals on screen. The numpad names match the visible direction and are identical to the arrows:\par
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent kp7\ \ $\nwarrow$\ up-left\ \ \ \ \ \ kp9\ \ $\nearrow$\ up-right\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ (kp7\ ==\ left,\ kp9\ ==\ up)\\kp1\ \ $\swarrow$\ down-left\ \ \ \ kp3\ \ $\searrow$\ down-right\ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ (kp1\ ==\ down,\ kp3\ ==\ right)\par}
Use \texttt{kp7/kp9/kp1/kp3}. On a clear path, alternating two directions moves horizontally or vertically across the screen:\par
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent screen-right\ :\ kp3,\ kp9,\ kp3,\ kp9,\ ...\ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ screen-left\ :\ kp7,\ kp1,\ ...\\screen-down\ \ :\ kp3,\ kp1,\ kp3,\ kp1,\ ...\ \ \ \ \ \\\ \ \ \ screen-up\ \ \ :\ kp7,\ kp9,\ ...\par}
\texttt{hold} is the number of frames the key stays down, not tiles travelled; it does not follow paths, turn or avoid obstacles. Use short taps where the route is unclear and longer holds on a confirmed clear stretch. A \texttt{hold} below 5 is refused: the game reads the keyboard once per loop, and a press released within one loop is lost. The default is 10.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}世界是等角视角，四个\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}轴在画面上都是斜的。九宫数字键的名称对应画面上的方向，与方向键等效：\end{CJK}\par
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent kp7\ \ $\nwarrow$\ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}左上\end{CJK}\ \ \ \ \ \ kp9\ \ $\nearrow$\ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}右上\end{CJK}\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（\end{CJK}kp7\ ==\\\ \ \ \ left\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，\end{CJK}kp9\ ==\ up\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}）\end{CJK}\\kp1\ \ $\swarrow$\ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}左下\end{CJK}\ \ \ \ \ \ kp3\ \ $\searrow$\ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}右下\end{CJK}\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（\end{CJK}kp1\ ==\\\ \ \ \ down\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，\end{CJK}kp3\ ==\ right\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}）\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}请用\end{CJK} \texttt{kp7/kp9/kp1/kp3}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。路径畅通时，交替按两个方向可沿画面的水平或垂直方向前进：\end{CJK}\par
{\ttfamily\scriptsize\raggedright\noindent \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}画面向右：\end{CJK}kp3,\ kp9,\ kp3,\ kp9,\ ...\ \ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}画面向左：\end{CJK}kp7,\\\ \ \ \ kp1,\ ...\\\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}画面向下：\end{CJK}kp3,\ kp1,\ kp3,\ kp1,\ ...\ \ \ \ \ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}画面向上：\end{CJK}kp7,\\\ \ \ \ kp9,\ ...\par}
\texttt{hold} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}是按键保持的帧数，不是\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}格数；它不会沿路、转弯或避障。路线不明时短按，已确认畅通的路段再长按。\end{CJK}\texttt{hold} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}小于\end{CJK} 5 \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}会被拒绝：游戏每个主回圈只读一次键盘，按下与放开落在同一次回圈内的按键等于没发生。预设为\end{CJK} 10\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries Interacting\par}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item enter and space confirm, advance dialogue and investigate. For a person or container, stand on an adjacent tile facing the target, then press enter or space. Story events triggered by stepping on a tile are separate.\item Any key advances ordinary dialogue. Answer choices and \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（Ｙ／Ｎ）\end{CJK} prompts with y and n.\item esc opens the menu. In a building: \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK} / \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK} / \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK} / \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}. On the world map also \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}離隊\end{CJK} (dismiss a party member) and \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}系統\end{CJK} (save, load, quit). The game saves only from the world map.\end{itemize}

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item enter \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}与\end{CJK} space \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}确定、推进对话、调查。与人物或容器互动时，站在相邻格并朝向目标，再按\end{CJK} enter \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}或\end{CJK} space\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。踩到特定格子触发的剧情是另一种机制。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}一般对话可用任意键推进；选项与\end{CJK}“\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（Ｙ／Ｎ）\end{CJK}”\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}用\end{CJK} y \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}与\end{CJK} n \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}作答。\end{CJK}\item esc \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}开启选单。建筑内：\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}／\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}／\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}／\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。大地图上另有\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}離隊與系統\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（存档、读档、离开）。游戏只在大地图上存档。\end{CJK}\end{itemize}
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries The world\par}
You play \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}小蝦米\end{CJK}, who wakes inside the world of Jin Yong's novels. The way home is to find the fourteen books scattered across the land. Characters from the novels can be recruited and their martial arts learned. Battles are turn-based between teams, in an order set by \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}. A fallen character, a lost battle and the end of the game are different events; whether play continues after a defeat depends on the encounter.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}这个世界\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}你是\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}小蝦米\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，醒来后身处金庸小说的世界。回家的办法是找齐散落各地的十四本小说。小说中的人物可以入队，武功可以习得。战斗是团队回合制，行动顺序依\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。角色倒下、战斗失败与游戏结束是三件不同的事；败北后能否继续取决于该场遭遇。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\small\bfseries Field manual: controls and game knowledge\par}
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\small\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}实战手册：操作与游戏知识\end{CJK}\par}
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries First: get the compass\par}
Many locations open only after the opening encounter at \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}, the house of the hermit.\par
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item In the starting house, talk to the \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}軟體娃娃\end{CJK} until nothing new is said, search the room, then find the doorway out.\item On the world map, follow the small path south to \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}, near \texttt{[388,325]}. Talk to \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢\end{CJK}, the hermit, then investigate the cabinet beside him to get the \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}羅盤\end{CJK} (compass).\item Highlight the compass in \texttt{esc $\rightarrow$ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}} to read the coordinates of the party and the boat. Use them to check your position whenever the route is unclear.\end{enumerate}
In the original game, paying the waiter at \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}河洛客棧\end{CJK}, the Heluo Inn, buys directions to \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}. They are not required to enter.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}最优先：拿到\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}羅盤\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}许多地点要在\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的开局事件完成后才会开放。\end{CJK}\par
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}开场小屋里先跟\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}軟體娃娃\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}对话到没有新内容，搜完屋内，再找到门口离开。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}进入大地图后，沿小路往南前往\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，参考座标约\end{CJK} \texttt{[388,325]}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。先跟\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}对话，再调查他身旁的柜子，取得\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}羅盤\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}在\end{CJK} \texttt{esc $\rightarrow$ \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}中选中\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}羅盤\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，可读到人物和船的座标。路线不明时用它核对位置。\end{CJK}\end{enumerate}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}原版中，付钱给\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}河洛客棧\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的小二可以买到前往\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的指路。不指路也能进入。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries Controls and menus\par}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item Move with \texttt{kp1 kp3 kp7 kp9} or the arrows; they are the same four axes. Holding a key keeps sending the same direction without following paths, turning or avoiding obstacles.\item For a person or container, stand adjacent, face the target, and press space or enter. Stepping on a tile can trigger a separate story event. In a battle, choose commands and targets through its menu.\item \texttt{esc} opens the menu anywhere. Arrows move the highlight, space or enter confirms, \texttt{esc} backs out.\item \texttt{y} and \texttt{n} answer \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（Ｙ／Ｎ）\end{CJK}. Any key advances ordinary dialogue.\end{itemize}
The world-map menu holds \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK} heal, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK} cure poison, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK} items, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK} status, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}離隊\end{CJK} dismiss a party member and \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}系統\end{CJK} system. Inside a location the first four are available; saving, loading and dismissal need the world map. Recruitment happens through dialogue.\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}: choose a healer and a patient. Healing needs at least 50 \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體力\end{CJK} and enough medical ability for the injury.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}: choose a curer and a patient; the effect depends on the curing ability and the poison.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}: a story item is used on a person or object while standing adjacent and facing it; medicines, equipment and manuals choose their user in the item menu. Five kinds: story items; pills that restore or raise attributes; hidden weapons, usable only in battle; weapons and armour, equippable by some characters; manuals, which a party member studies to gain attributes or a skill.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}: health, internal energy, stamina, experience and the battle attributes, with a second page of portrait, equipment and skills. A character learns at most ten martial arts, each to level ten, and studies one manual at a time.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}系統\end{CJK}: three save slots, load, and quit. Save often.\end{itemize}
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}操作与选单\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}用\end{CJK} \texttt{kp1 kp3 kp7 kp9} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}或方向键，两者是同样的四个轴。长按持续输入同一方向，不会沿路、转弯或避障。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}与人物或容器互动：站在相邻格朝向目标，按\end{CJK} space \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}或\end{CJK} enter\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。踩到特定格子触发的剧情是另一种事件。战斗中经由选单选择指令和目标。\end{CJK}\item \texttt{esc} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}在任何地方开启选单。方向键\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}反白，\end{CJK}space \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}或\end{CJK} enter \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}确定，\end{CJK}\texttt{esc} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}返回上一层。\end{CJK}\item \texttt{y} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}与\end{CJK} \texttt{n} \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}回答\end{CJK}“\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}（Ｙ／Ｎ）\end{CJK}”\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。任意键推进一般对话。\end{CJK}\end{itemize}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}大地图选单有\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}離隊\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}系統\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}；小场景只有前四项。存档、读档和\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}離隊\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}要在大地图上；入队经由对话。\end{CJK}\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \textbf{\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：选医者，再选被医者。医者\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}需达\end{CJK} 50\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，且\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}能力要够得上伤势。\end{CJK}\item \textbf{\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：选\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}者，再选中毒者；效果取决于\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}能力和中毒程度。\end{CJK}\item \textbf{\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：剧情\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}要站在相邻格朝向目标使用；药物、装备和秘笈在\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}选单中选择使用者。五类：剧情\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}；回复或提升属性的药丸；只在战斗中可用的\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}暗器\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}；部分人物可装备的武器防具；队员修练后增加属性或学会武功的秘笈。\end{CJK}\item \textbf{\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：生命、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}內力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}經驗\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}和战斗属性；第二页是大头照、装备和已学武功。每人最多学十种武功，每种最高十重，同时只修练一本秘笈。\end{CJK}\item \textbf{\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}系統\end{CJK}}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：三个存档位、读档、离开。常存档。\end{CJK}\end{itemize}
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries Battles\par}
Battles are turn-based. Order follows \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}; waiting moves the current character later in the round. Stamina, internal energy, ability and remaining movement decide which commands are available; read the menu.\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK} move: choose a position in range. The commands that remain afterwards change.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}攻擊\end{CJK} attack: choose a martial art, then its target, direction or area.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}用毒\end{CJK} poison, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK} cure, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK} heal: need the ability, the resource and a suitable target.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK} items: choose the use and the target, then check the quantity.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}等待\end{CJK} wait: delay this character's action, which is not the same as ending it.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK} status: attributes, equipment and martial arts.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}休息\end{CJK} rest: end the action and recover some stamina.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}自動\end{CJK} auto: the game controls the whole party's battle actions.\end{itemize}
A fallen character is not necessarily dead, and a lost battle is not always the end of the game. Some defeats end the run; read the story and the result.\par
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}战斗\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}战斗是回合制。顺序依\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}；等待会把当前角色的行动延后。\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}內力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、能力和剩余步数决定可用的指令，以选单为准。\end{CJK}\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：在范围内选位置。\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}移動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}后可用的指令会改变。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}攻擊\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：先选武功，再选目标、方向或范围。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}用毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：需要相应能力、资源和合适的目标。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：选用法和目标，之后核对数量。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}等待：延后此角色的行动，不等于结束行动。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}狀態\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：属性、装备和武功。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}休息：结束行动并恢复部分\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}自動\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}：由游戏控制全队的战斗行动。\end{CJK}\end{itemize}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}角色倒下不一定是死亡，战斗失败也不一定是游戏结束。有些败北会结束这一局；看剧情和战斗结果。\end{CJK}\par
\switchcolumn*
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries Attributes\par}
Visible: health, internal energy, stamina, experience, attack, defence, \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}, healing, poison, curing and the weapon skills. Base attack, defence and \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK} cap at 100; equipment adds on top. Some skills and items need minimum values.\par
Hidden:\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體質\end{CJK} sets the health gained per level.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}資質\end{CJK} sets how fast skills are learned. A few skills are reserved for characters with poor \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}資質\end{CJK}.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}道德\end{CJK} moves with your actions and is read from the mirror in \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK} with space. Too low and upright characters refuse to join; some paths need a specific range.\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}名望\end{CJK} changes with story events and battles and affects later events.\end{itemize}
\switchcolumn
\footnotesize\setlength{\parskip}{2pt}
{\footnotesize\bfseries \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}属性\end{CJK}\par}
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}可见：生命、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}內力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體力\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}經驗\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}攻擊\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}防禦\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}醫療\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}用毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}解毒\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}和各项兵器技巧。\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}攻擊\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}、\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}防禦\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}和\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}輕功\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的基础值上限\end{CJK} 100\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}，装备另计。部分武功和\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}物品\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}有最低要求。\end{CJK}\par
\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}隐藏：\end{CJK}\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,topsep=1pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt]\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}體質\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}决定\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}升級\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}时增加的生命。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}資質\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}决定学武功的快慢。少数武功留给\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}資質\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}差的人。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}道德\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}随行为变动，对著\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}南賢居\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}的镜子按\end{CJK} space \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}可以查看。太低则正派人物拒绝入队；部分路线需要特定区间。\end{CJK}\item \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{bsmi}名望\end{CJK}\begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn}随剧情和战斗变动，影响后续事件。\end{CJK}\end{itemize}
\switchcolumn*
